channel.title: Power Back Weekly
channel.description: The Colorado record, read out loud. Every Sunday, Power Back Weekly walks through what your lawmakers actually did that week: the votes, the bills that moved, and whose record changed, straight from the public record and in plain English. Bonus episodes drop when something big moves. From The Q Collective, a nonpartisan, citizen-powered accountability project. Each episode opens with founder maveriQ B Jackson in his own voice; the rest is read by an AI voice from our published data, and every fact links back to the record at theqcollective.org.
